locked_design.source: DOC01 p11 Model 3 equation and hierarchical regression; DOC01 p13 diagnostic
rules: Keep outcome years, relative-ROA outcome, eleven strategy concepts, all four named controls, intercept, and the M1/M2/M3 progression fixed.
M3_SQ is a separately reported robustness model, not an equivalent alternative to M3. Unreported strategy-control regressions are unavailable, not an equivalent control-list choice.
No bank/year fixed effects in origin or equivalent set. Year fixed effects would absorb the explicitly included market-year growth variable.

No alternative estimator is put into the equivalent set: WLS is explicit. Reversing the weights to 1/market_share or premultiplying by market_share instead of its square root contradicts stated variance model.
The eleven category concepts and absolute-z sum are explicit; pairwise/Euclidean distances discussed as future research are not equivalent implementations.
Balanced-survivor panels, all-US markets, thrift inclusion and alternative outcomes are not open decisions under the stated design.

compatible_crossings.rule: A05_ENDPOINT requires A08_ENDPOINT; A08_ENDPOINT need not force survival of all quarters. A05_AVAILABLE is allowed only with A08_O and changes its four-quarter completeness rule. A08_FIVE requires prior Q4 plus all current endpoints, regardless of average-item availability. A09 quarterly stock levels retain their own coverage requirements.
compatible_crossings.source: DOC01 p9 Sample and data; Dependent variable

compatible_crossings.rule: A12_FARMLAND requires A15_DOMESTIC and scope-compatible income. Adjust real-estate and other-loan residual amounts together; never double-count farmland.
A11 and A13 always cross by subtracting the selected four loan category definitions from the selected loan total. A14_RESIDUAL must use those same ten category amounts.

A09_QUARTERS and A09_RATIO_MEANS require quarterly strategy/deposit coverage and annual aggregation before annual norms. A17_DEC is a date-matching rationale chiefly for A09_O; its crossing with averaged deposits remains an uncertain mixed timing variant.
compatible_crossings.source: DOC01 p9 Independent variable; DOC01 p10 real growth

compatible_crossings.rule: A04_ANALYTIC and A07_BENCH must use a single explicitly frozen membership mask and deletion order. Do not iterate sample membership until numerical targets agree.
compatible_crossings.source: DOC01 p9 All-bank means; DOC01 p11 outlier deletion

compatible_crossings.rule: For every variant, M1/M2/M3 nested tests require identical rows and weights. Apply any source or benchmark variant to current and lagged outcomes consistently.
compatible_crossings.source: DOC01 p11 Hierarchical regression and F-tests

compatible_crossings.rule: A18_MEAN1 and A21_CENTER require back-conversion of SSE and coefficients/covariance respectively for published-scale comparisons. The conditional identity A06_IDENTITY is equivalent only after the equality is established from definitions, not fitted results.
Non-equivalent levels are outside equivalent replication family. Uncertain levels require reconciliation before execution. Wider space is off by default.
